description: This file provides utility functions for managing cookies in JavaScript, including setting, retrieving, and deleting cookies with optional attributes.

methods.name: setCookie(sName, sValue, options)
methods.description: Creates or updates a cookie with specified name, value, and optional parameters such as expiration, path, domain, and secure flag.

methods.name: getCookie(sName)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cookie by its name, returning null if the cookie does not exist.

methods.name: deleteCookie(sName, options)
methods.description: Deletes a cookie by setting its expiration to a past date, with optional attributes to match the original cookie's scope.
